EmailTemplate.subject: Is team spirit in your blood? Prove it.
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear <Sponsor Name>,
This fall, you can help fight against blood shortage by participating in the largest blood donation competition of our lifetime.
This fall, you can help fight against blood shortage by participating in the largest blood donation competition of our lifetime.
Your school can proudly participate in “The We Give Blood Drive,” sponsored by Abbott and the Big Ten Conference®. Tap into the love and competitiveness of college football and energize your students, alumni, and fans to donate blood to support their school. We’re calling on all students, alumni and fans to rebuild the nation’s blood supply by pitting school against school in a conference-wide donation competition by donating blood with The American Red Cross.
From September 26 – December 6, 2024, donors can participate in “The We Give Blood Drive” by donating blood for their chance to win tickets to the 2024 Discover® Big Ten® Football Championship Game on December 7, 2024, while also helping your school have a chance to win $1 million to advance student or community health.*
Joining this challenge can be done in these easy steps:
1. Visit redcrossblood.org/give to schedule their Red Cross blood donation appointment
2. Submit your donation at www.bigten.org/abbott/submit
For more information, visit www.bigten.org/abbott.
*This offer and any resulting prize during the competition are non-transferable and not redeemable for cash. Visit https://bigten.votigo.com/fbsweeps/pages/BigTenWeGiveBloodSweepstakes/rules for the terms and conditions of the sweepstakes.
The American Red Cross is not a sponsor of the sweepstakes and is not responsible for the creation, execution or fulfillment of the We Give Blood Drive, or any aspect of the prize.
